"Peritoneum," on the other hand, is the thin, slippery membrane that lines the inside of the abdomen and pelvis. "Absence" suggests that there's no peritoneal tissue, which can be a sign of peritonitis (inflammation of the peritonum) or other conditions. "Pelvic" refers to the area around the pelvis, and "peritonium" is part of this area.
